# Kenwise

> Kenwise is an open-source personal AI assistant that understands what you mean before it acts. One model reads every message with what it knows about you (memory, a dated history, the work under way), asks only what it can't settle while stating its assumptions, then hands the job to OpenClaw agents running in docker. A reviewer checks each result against what you meant and sends it back until it is right. Everything is stored locally in one SQLite file with full-text search. It runs as a local daemon on macOS and Linux with Node.js 22.19+. It was called EV during development; code and settings (`EV_*`) still use that name.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, status, install, how it works

- [Memory](docs/assistant/MEMORY_TYPES.md): memory kinds, said versus guessed, history, forgetting
- [Behaviours](verify/BEHAVIOURS.md): what it is meant to do, checked by `npm run verify`
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md)
